ITEM 1 | Mixed salad leaves in a loose heap, a mix of pale green curly leaves, dark red-purple tinged leaves, and deep green flat leaves, with glossy-looking moist surfaces and no visible dressing; leaves are torn and ruffled, covering roughly 60% of the bowl's footprint with a mounded height of about 3-4 cm | 85

ITEM 2 | Thinly sliced red onion rings and half-rings, pale purple-white with translucent edges, scattered throughout the greens, each slice about 0.3-0.5 cm thick and 2-4 cm across, raw and crisp-looking with no cooking marks | 25

ITEM 3 | Small dark green leaf pieces with a slightly glossy surface, some folded, scattered among the lettuce on the right side of the bowl, each about 4-6 cm long, flat and lying close to the surface | 10
